parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster where the resource group is located
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the service instance
parameters.name: instance_name

items.description_en: The information about a single injected fault

FaultArgs.description_en:
The parameters for each fault type.

CpuFullloadTask (CPU full load fault)
   `{ "FaultType": "CpuFullloadTask", "FaultArgs": { "FaultAction": "fullload", "CpuPercent": 50 } }`

MemLoadTask (Memory load fault)
   `{ "FaultType": "MemLoadTask", "FaultArgs": { "FaultAction": "load", "MemPercent": 80 } }`

NetworkTask (Network fault)
   3.a. NetworkDelayAction (Network delay)
   `{ "FaultType": "NetworkTask", "FaultArgs": { "FaultAction": "delay", "Time": 3000, "Offset": 100 } }`
   3.b. NetworkCorruptAction (Network packet corruption)
   `{ "FaultType": "NetworkTask", "FaultArgs": { "FaultAction": "corrupt", "Percent": 50 } }`
   3.c. NetworkLossAction (Network packet loss)
   `{ "FaultType": "NetworkTask", "FaultArgs": { "FaultAction": "loss", "Percent": 30 } }`

DiskBurnTask (Disk read/write fault)
   `{ "FaultType": "DiskBurnTask", "FaultArgs": { "FaultAction": "burn", "Read": true, "Write": true, "Size": 100 } }`

DiskFillTask (Disk fill fault)
   `{ "FaultType": "DiskFillTask", "FaultArgs": { "FaultAction": "fill", "Percent": 80 } }`

FaultStatus.description_en:
The status of the fault. Valid values:

FaultNotInjected: The task was created, but the fault was not successfully injected.

FaultInjectedSuccess: The fault was successfully injected.

FaultInjectedFailure: The fault injection failed. The failure may be caused by parameter errors or system issues
FaultStatus.description_zh:
故障状态：
FaultNotInjected： 任务已经创建但是无成功注入。
FaultInjectedSuccess：故障成功注入。
FaultInjectedFailure: 故障注入失败，可能由于参数错误、系统问题等

FaultStatusMessage.description_en: The description of the fault injection

FaultType.description_en: The fault type. Valid values:CpuFullloadTask: a CPU full load fault.MemLoadTask: a memory load fault.NetworkTask: a network fault.DiskBurnTask: a disk read/write fault.DiskFillTask: a disk fill fault
FaultType.description_zh: 故障类型。1. CpuFullloadTask: CPU满载故障；2. MemLoadTask: 内存负载故障；3. NetworkTask: 网络故障；4. DiskBurnTask: 磁盘读写故障； 5. DiskFillTask: 磁盘填充故障；
